faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Visakhapatnam Port Authority to fill vacancies for the Deputy Chief Law Officer position under the General Administration Department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Deputy Chief Law Officer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Deputy Chief Law Officer post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for the Deputy Chief Law Officer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Law from a recognized University along with nine years of executive experience in a legal establishment of an industrial, commercial, or government undertaking.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit to apply for this job?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years as of 01.09.2026, with an age relaxation of up to 55 years applicable for existing officers and employees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary scale ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,80,000 along with DA, cafeteria allowances, HRA, and other benefits.

faq.question: Q6. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 29-09-2026 and the last date to submit the application form is 28-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for submitting the application form.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Visakhapatnam Port Authority Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written examination or interview, carrying a weightage of 85% for the written examination and 15% for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. How should candidates submit their final applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications online through the official portal and send the printed copy through the proper channel to the Secretary, Visakhapatnam Port Authority.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can check the official website https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in to access the notification PDF and complete your online application.
